Leah Park: Quick sync — Galatea asked for a short perf note + two commercial options after yesterdays POC. Posting the key numbers and a recommended ask.

Marco Ruiz: Ran three runs with their traffic template: steady 300 qps chat-gen, two 90s microbursts to 1.2k qps, embedding mix ~120 qps. Model: redwood-7B-quant (latency profile). Pool: 5x T4-equivalent nodes, autoscale enabled.

Marco Ruiz: Aggregated latencies (chat tokens): p50 78ms, p95 300ms, p99 950ms. Embeds p50 45ms, p95 140ms. During microbursts p99 hit ~2.1s for ~15s while new workers attached KV shards. No request failures, retries negligible.

Olga Karpova: Infra notes: tails align with KV prefix misses + attach time when scaling. If we set autoscaler min_idle=1 warm node and pre-populate top prefixes, p99 during 1.2k bursts drops <1.1s. Also saw a small network egress queue on node-2 during peak for ~12s.

Samir Patel: Cost snapshot: this run consumed ~1.9 GPU-hours; estimated run cost ~$820. Pricing proposal: (A) Consumption: $0.14 / 1k chat tokens, $0.02 / 1k embed tokens (proj ~2.5M tokens/day => ~$11k/mo). (B) Reserved pilot: 3-month pilot, dedicated pool sized for 350 qps sustained + 2x burst buffer, flat $6,200/mo (includes 1 warm node + SLA + one free warm day/month).

Leah Park: Draft customer blurb: "Short bench: sustained 300 qps with p95 ~300ms, p99 ~950ms; 1.2k bursts show short p99 spikes caused by autoscale + KV attach. Recommend enabling 1 warm node and prefix pre-population to keep p99 <1.1s. See attached ops link and pricing options."

Marco Ruiz: +1. Add ops-bot link and small repro playbook.

Olga Karpova: +1. Recommend we offer a 24hr free pre-warm at pilot start to validate against their real traffic.

ops-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/poc-runs/1795554321/ (prometheus, histograms, loadgen-config).

Leah Park: Thanks all — I'll send the note to Galatea and paste their reply here.
